F.D.N.Y. Firefighter — victim spawn maps

Top-down, per level. Grey = level walls. Each victim = one colour and one letter. A filled circle with the bare letter (e.g. B) is that victim's origin spawn; a ring with letter+number (B1, B2) is an alternate. The game picks ONE spot per victim at random each load; the dashed line links a victim's options. Coordinates in spawns.json. Tell me which spots are the good ones.
